create_cheetah_run_env: create a Cheetah running environment using the Run class with default configuration
run_cheetah_reset: run the Cheetah environment reset method with a JAX random key to initialize the simulation
run_cheetah_step: run the Cheetah environment step method with a state and action array to advance the simulation
get_cheetah_observation: get the observation array from the Cheetah environment by concatenating qpos and qvel data
get_cheetah_reward: get the running reward based on torso linear velocity using tolerance-based reward function
